blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) is looking to test a “barrier-less” system at tollways before December to help ease traffic congestion during the holiday rush, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said. Dizon said the initiative is being pursued under the directive of President Marcos, with the department targeting an initial rollout before the expected surge in motorists during the Christmas season. “Before this December, we need to pilot the barrier up for the tollways,” he said.
